No cancel, no admin, no setter.
audit.verdict_RECONCILED: ✅ Timelock CORE mechanics PROVEN sound (EXEC-1/2/3/4 refuted as exploits): schedule() is Governor-only (isProposer set once in constructor, no setter); execute() permissionless but gated by readyAt + 7d delay + executed-flag-before-calls (CEI, no replay/reentry); hashOperation=keccak(abi.encode) collision-safe; salt=proposalId unique; atomic batch. NO permissionless break, NO double-exec. Residual is ALL DESIGN/HANDOFF: EXEC-1 (High-design) NO CANCELLER — a passed-but-malicious/buggy batch is unstoppable on-chain once scheduled (only the 7d delay to react). EXEC-2 (Medium) IMMUTABLE proposer — a buggy Governor cannot be replaced without redeploy + full re-handoff. EXEC-3 (Medium) 7d MIN_DELAY is the ONLY reaction window + only emergency lever. EXEC-4 (Low) permissionless direct execute() desyncs Governor.p.executed (cosmetic; actions still run exactly once; fix pre-handoff by gating to PROPOSER or reconciling). EXEC-5 (Low) no expiry. These are deliberate credible-neutrality trade-offs the user must consciously accept for the irreversible handoff.
